theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (f : Eucl P → ℝ), NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)) → Measurable f → (∀ p : Eucl P → Prop, (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), p x) → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t})), p x) → ∀ᵐ t ∂(volume : Measure ℝ), NullMeasurableSet (M ∩ f ⁻¹' {t}) (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P))
